purpose: Exploit the exact Tovey/ReducedFewSat bounded-occurrence image rather than arbitrary degree<=3 CNF. Show that the one-conflict-dropped matching relaxation decomposes into two-phase implication cycles and that its minimum number of remaining LM defects is exactly the minimum number of unsatisfied clauses of the original 3-CNF. This closes the idea that generic matching-defect minimization creates an easier global objective.

source_normalization.input: An arbitrary 3-CNF phi with no repeated variable inside a clause.
source_normalization.copy_step: For every occurrence j of original variable x, replace that occurrence by a fresh copy x_j with the inherited literal sign.
source_normalization.consistency_cycle: If x has copies x_1,...,x_k, add the 2-clauses I_j=(not x_j OR x_{j+1}) cyclically. These implications force all copies of x to have the same truth value.
source_normalization.occurrence_property: Every copy x_j now occurs exactly once in an original 3-clause, once negatively in outgoing I_j, and once positively in incoming I_{j-1}. Thus every copy has degree exactly three and mixed polarity.

source_aligned_P3_labels.rule: For each copy x_j, choose L_j to be its unique original-3-clause occurrence. Of the two implication occurrences, call R_j the one having the same literal sign as L_j and M_j the one having the opposite sign.
source_aligned_P3_labels.relaxation: Keep the pair constraint {M_j,R_j} as one right resource q_j and drop only the conflict {L_j,M_j}. The L_j occurrence has its own singleton right resource l_j.
source_aligned_P3_labels.cycle_geometry: For every original variable x, q_j is adjacent exactly to implication clauses I_{j-1} and I_j. Hence the bipartite subgraph on {I_j} and {q_j} is an even cycle C_{2k}.

two_phase_lemma.name: IMPLICATION_CYCLE_HAS_EXACTLY_TWO_PERFECT_MATCHING_PHASES
two_phase_lemma.statement: A left-perfect matching of all implication clauses to q-resources chooses one of exactly two alternating phases independently for each original variable cycle.
two_phase_lemma.phase0: Every I_j is matched to q_j (the outgoing occurrence of x_j).
two_phase_lemma.phase1: Every I_j is matched to q_{j+1}, equivalently q_j is matched from I_{j-1} (the incoming occurrence of x_j).
two_phase_lemma.truth_map: Interpret phase0 as x=0 and phase1 as x=1.

literal_defect_lemma.name: LM_DEFECT_IFF_SELECTED_LITERAL_IS_FALSE
proof: If the inherited original literal L_j is positive, M_j is the outgoing negative implication occurrence. It is selected exactly in phase0, i.e. x=0, exactly when the positive literal is false.
If L_j is negative, M_j is the incoming positive implication occurrence. It is selected exactly in phase1, i.e. x=1, exactly when the negative literal is false.
Therefore selecting L_j as the witness of its original clause creates the dropped LM conflict exactly when that literal is false under the phase assignment.

main_theorem.name: MIN_MATCHING_DEFECT_EQUALS_MIN_UNSAT
main_theorem.statement: Let d*(phi) be the minimum number of dropped LM conflict pairs simultaneously selected by any left-perfect matching of the one-conflict-dropped source-aligned relaxation of red(phi). Then d*(phi)=min_a |{C in phi : C(a)=false}|.
proof: Fix one of the two matching phases for every original-variable implication cycle. This is exactly a Boolean assignment a of phi.
Every original 3-clause node is incident only to its three L singleton resources, so its witness choice is independent of all other 3-clause witness choices once the phases are fixed.

By LM_DEFECT_IFF_SELECTED_LITERAL_IS_FALSE, a clause can choose a zero-defect witness iff it contains a true literal under a. If all three literals are false, every possible witness contributes exactly one defect.
Hence for fixed a the minimum number of LM defects is exactly the number of clauses falsified by a. Minimizing over all cycle phases/assignments proves the identity.

algorithmic_consequence.positive: The source alignment collapses each entire copy-consistency cycle to one exact Boolean phase; there is no hidden extra matching freedom in the implication layer.
anti_loop: Do not claim that minimizing the number of remaining matching conflict pairs is an easier convex/matching objective: on the canonical source image it is exactly Min-UNSAT, equivalently the complement of Max-3SAT optimization.
Do not treat neutral alternating moves on implication cycles as new information: changing the cycle phase is exactly flipping the corresponding original Boolean variable.
The source-aligned relaxation is an exact reparameterization of the original assignment landscape, not a polynomial contraction by itself.
not_killed: A genuinely global operation that changes many variable-cycle phases with a provably polynomial exact progress measure.
A nonlocal algebraic cancellation identity that sums/cancels all phase choices without enumerating assignments.

next_target.name: E8_GLOBAL_PHASE_CANCELLATION_OR_NONLOCAL_PROGRESS_V3_0
next_target.directive: Stop generic conflict-matching optimization. Any next step must exploit a global invariant across many Tovey implication-cycle phases that is not merely the original assignment vector or Min-UNSAT objective. Require a polynomial-size representation and exact witness reconstruction.
